summary: The note describes the 2014 collapse of Marussia Motors, the Russian car company. In April 2014 the company was disbanded and its staff left to join a government-run technical institute. The Marussia F1 team, a British entity, continued unaffected by the car company's disbandment. On 7 November 2014 the administrator announced that the F1 team had ceased trading.
one_line: Marussia Motors, a Russian car company, was disbanded in April 2014, and its British Marussia F1 team later ceased trading in November 2014.
key_facts: In April 2014, the Marussia Motors company was disbanded.
Marussia Motors staff left to join a government-run technical institute after the company was disbanded.
The Marussia F1 team continued unaffected by the disbandment of Marussia Motors because it was a British entity independent of the Russian car company.
On 7 November 2014, the administrator announced that the Marussia F1 team had ceased trading.
